title: Multi-round discussion
description: Define multi-model discussions as a workflow: rounds run serially and steps inside a round run in parallel. Placeholders bind to real models at chat time.
name: Name
placeholderRequired: At least one model placeholder is required
roundRequired: Every round needs at least one step
roundIndependent: Every model answers independently in this round.
roundSeesPrevious: Every model sees the previous round and all earlier discussion in this round.
summaryHint: After the rounds, the summary model turns the successful turns into the final answer for the user.
workflowHint: Rounds run serially and steps inside a round run in parallel. From round 2 on, every model sees the previous round and all earlier discussion; the summary model then writes the final answer. Placeholders bind to real models at chat time; this page only defines the structure.
